description: ​Trading Chart by MAQ Software translates historical trading records into an easy-to-read chart. Gray bars signify low and high price values. Red or green bars superimposed over the low and high values indicate the direction the stock moved. Business Uses: Finance - Analyze the state of the stock market to make informed decisions Management - Highlight your organization’s stock value over time Leadership - Analyze the state of competitor stock to inform valuable mergers and business opportunities Key Features: Color-coded bars (red bar indicates a stock’s price has dropped; a green bar indicates the price rose) Customizable price ranges and time increments What's New in 4.0.0: Support for context menu Contact Us: Thank you for using Trading Chart by MAQ Software. Do you have questions about this or any of our other Power BI custom visuals? Check out our community pages on Zendesk: https://bit.ly/maqsoftware-support
